name: tests-keys
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun test core/runtime-keys.test.ts core/compile.test.ts core/count-write-frames.test.ts core/quorum-laws.test.ts core/sample-cache.test.ts core/keyterms.test.ts core/pairs.test.ts core/exists-support.test.ts core/small-laws.test.ts core/cube-width.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -40

name: check
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check 2>&1 | tail -30

name: prof-generation
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && mkdir -p prof && GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 120 bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-md --cpu-prof-dir=prof --cpu-prof-interval=2000 research/track-gen/t13-generation.ts mldr > gen.out 2> gen.err; echo EXIT $?; grep -v 'T13_DATA' gen.err | grep '\[infer join small instance\|\[infer join pool\|"phases"' | cut -c1-400; echo PROFILE; f=$(ls prof/*.md | head -1); sed -n 1,60p "$f"
